notes: The byline 'Darth Vader "The Dark" Lord of The Sith' is a prank name; the deck is credited to the DeckTech handle The Dark as plain text (no player page), as with decks 18156 and 18394.
Posted 7 August 2001 with no Coruscant-set cards, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

Starting cards as posted under 'Starting (7)': the Objective, Death Star, Alderaan, Death Star: Docking Bay 327, Heading For The Medical Frigate, Mobilization Points and Combat Response; these count toward the 60.
Heading For The Medical Frigate is a Light card; the strategy's update says 'I meant to have Prepared Defenses', so the row is Prepared Defenses.

The deck totals 69 as published. The section headers do not all match the lists (Starships 23 vs 22 listed, Locations 6 vs 8 listed). The strategy's update swaps Vengeance, an Ion Cannon, a TIE Interceptor and a Turbolaser Battery for A Day Long Remembered, Death Star Assault Squadron, Dreaded Imperial Starfleet and Put All Sections On Alert; the list is kept as published.

Posted 'Alderaan', 'Docking Bay 327', 'Yavin 4', 'Hoth', 'Tatooine', 'Kessel' and 'Bespin' dested the Dark pages Alderaan (Dark), Death Star: Docking Bay 327 (Dark), Yavin 4 (Dark), Hoth (Dark), Tatooine (Dark) (Premiere), Kessel (Dark) and Bespin (Dark); 'Death Star Detention Block Corridor' dested the Dark Premiere site Death Star: Detention Block Corridor.

Posted 'Death Star Superlaser' dested Superlaser; 'Vengance' dested Vengeance; 'Commander Merejek' dested Commander Merrejk; 'Major Turr Phenir' dested Major Turr Phennir; 'DS-161-4' dested DS-61-4; 'All Power to the Weapons' dested All Power To Weapons; 'TIE Interceptors' dested TIE Interceptor.
